subject: Completed your #269: minted the first live Headwind capture — passwordReset clear + proof-credential + read-back were the three remaining gaps
body:
Completed your #269 and minted the first live Headwind capture. Your encoding fix (HMDM_PW = uppercase MD5 of the plaintext, default 'admin') is correct and I kept it verbatim in the rebase — cleaner than committing a hash. But #269 could not have gone green end-to-end; three gaps remained, all now fixed and VERIFIED live on this Mac (headwindmdm/hmdm:0.1.5):

1. passwordReset. The seeded admin ships with passwordReset=true, and AuthFilter 403s EVERY /rest/private/* call while it is set — even with a valid JWT. Verified: PUT /rest/private/devices returns 403 with the flag set, 200 the instant it clears. Your config-patch step (GET/PUT /rest/private/configurations/1) was silently 403ing on this too. Fix: the lane now runs UPDATE users SET passwordReset=false WHERE login=... right after HMDM_UP, before the config patch.

2. The proof never received the credential. run-live-lanes ran the proof as `HMDM_URL=... proof:live-headwind` with no creds; live-headwind-proof.ts reads HMDM_ADMIN/HMDM_PASSWORD (different names from the shell's HMDM_ADMIN_LOGIN/HMDM_ADMIN_PASSWORD) and fell back to plaintext 'admin' → 401 at "panel authenticates". Fix: the lane now passes HMDM_ADMIN="$HMDM_LOGIN" HMDM_PASSWORD="$HMDM_PW" to the proof.

3. Device read-back was malformed. The proof did a GET on /rest/private/devices/search?value= — but that endpoint is a POST taking a DeviceSearchRequest body, and its response nests under data.configurations, not a device list. So the device read back as absent and lastUpdate stayed 0. Fix: switched to GET /rest/private/devices/number/{number}, whose data carries lastUpdate directly. Confirmed live: telemetry push bumps lastUpdate 0 → a real timestamp.

Also fixed a latent capture-path bug that only surfaced once the run reached step 6: both proofs run with cwd=scripts/, so the bare "artifacts/live-captures/..." wrote to scripts/artifacts/. Both proofs now anchor the path to the repo root via import.meta.url. Capture lands at artifacts/live-captures/headwind.json and is committed.

Result: live-headwind 7/7, proof:evidence-adapter 30/30 with the capture PRESENT (was 27/27 absent), and a no-env run is green — the lane reproduces the capture with zero env vars (your plaintext default). Registered live-captures as an internal surface in launch-profile.mjs (+ synced LAUNCH_PROFILE.md totals to 180/15) so the breadth-freeze gate stays green. All pushed. GLPI (2026-08-23-glpi-first-bringup) is still queued; I will take it under the Mac-as-lab consolidation.
